thesisQuality.note: 28% revenue growth with simultaneous double-digit ad-impression and ad-price growth demonstrates exceptional current product-market fit; durability is capped by AI-capex conversion uncertainty.

financialOperatingMomentum.note: Revenue growth is strong and liquidity substantial, but operating margin compressed to 31% and Q2 free cash flow was $784M amid $31.08B capex.

marketValuationOpportunity.note: At the 2026-09-24 close of $777.59 after a sharp rally, valuation requires continued strong growth and AI conversion rather than offering clear deep-value asymmetry.

catalystScore.note: AI product momentum and the next earnings read-through provide identifiable monetization tests, while economics remain partly early.

governancePower.note: SEC reporting and operating execution are established, but no fresh proxy package supports a stronger band.

alignment2036.note: Scaled digital communications, AI systems and advertising infrastructure are durable technology capabilities with broad economic relevance.

crossDivisionLeverage.note: Apps, messaging and AI products reuse compute/model infrastructure across products, while advertising remains the dominant economic engine.

bottleneckControl.note: Meta controls massive user distribution, data and model deployment, but underlying compute and power supply remain externally dependent.

scenarioRobustness.note: Large cash generation and global app usage support resilience while fixed AI infrastructure commitments increase downside sensitivity.

substitutionResilience.note: Scale, network effects and advertiser tooling create replacement friction, but user attention and AI interfaces remain competitive.

supplyChainResilience.note: Financial capacity supports procurement, but the AI build depends on external semiconductor, power and data-center supply chains.

pricingPower.note: Average price per ad rose 12% while ad impressions rose 14%, directly demonstrating strong current monetization and pricing capture.

risk.note: High AI infrastructure intensity, margin compression and legal/regulatory exposure are material, offset by strong demand and liquidity.

confidence.note: Operating claims have issuer and SEC support and current market evidence; confidence is reduced by missing fresh proxy detail and undisclosed project-level AI returns.

thesis: Meta combines exceptional advertising monetization scale with AI-driven product optionality, but the investment case depends materially on converting a very large infrastructure cycle into durable incremental monetization.
keyRisk: AI/data-center capex grows faster than durable monetization and compresses free-cash-flow conversion and returns on capital.
nextCatalyst: Q3 2026 operating results and evidence that AI-product adoption converts into measurable monetization or efficiency gains.
